sources.title: How to factor 2048 bit RSA integers in 8 hours using 20 million noisy qubits
sources.citation: Gidney and Ekerå 2019, logical-circuit formulas: 3n + 0.002n log2(n) logical qubits and 0.3n^3 + 0.0005n^3 log2(n) Toffolis.

sources.title: How to factor 2048-bit RSA integers with less than a million noisy qubits
sources.citation: Gidney 2025; accompanying code and data DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15347487. The physical-qubit estimate is retained as an explicit caveat and is not mixed with logical-Q thresholds.

sources.title: Quantum resource estimates for computing elliptic curve discrete logarithms
sources.citation: Roetteler, Naehrig, Svore and Lauter 2017: at most 9n + 2 ceil(log2(n)) + 10 qubits and 448n^3 log2(n) + 4090n^3 Toffoli gates.

sources.title: IBM Quantum development roadmap
sources.citation: Roadmap anchors inform the capability curve; interpolated and extrapolated points are visibly labelled below.
